questions.questionText: With reference to Figure 1, explain one likely reason for the overall trend in the real price of gas and electricity.
With reference to Extract A, discuss the likely effectiveness of ‘measures to open up and increase competition’ in the UK energy market.
With reference to Extract B, assess how the regulation of energy suppliers’ profits is likely to affect consumers and suppliers in the energy market.
With reference to Extract A and your own knowledge, examine two possible reasons for the change in price elasticity of demand for electricity over time.
With reference to Extract C and your own knowledge, discuss policies businesses and government might implement to reduce labour immobility to benefit the energy sector.

In September 2016 the government approved the building of an £18 billion nuclear power station, Hinkley Point C, which will supply 7% of UK electricity for up to 60 years. The power station is funded by Chinese and French investment. Evaluate the likely private costs and external costs involved in such major power station construction projects. Use an appropriate externalities diagram in your answer.

In July 2016 Apple’s share of the UK market for smartphones was 38%. Evaluate whether such a high market share for one company is in the consumer interest. Use appropriate diagrammatic analysis in your answer.
